data.title: 'Power Of The Small' on show now at River City Bangkok
data.description: Art lovers and wellness enthusiasts are invited to discover a new perspective on well-being and celebrate everyday progress during "Power Of The Small", which is running on the 2nd floor of River City Bangkok, daily from 11am to 8pm until Aug 15.

data.title: A once wary Hollywood slowly warms to AI
data.description: NEW YORK — Once wary of artificial intelligence (AI), Hollywood is now striking up partnerships with AI start-ups and weaving the technology into productions more and more openly, all while insisting the creative process itself will remain untouched.

data.title: International painting contest  accepting entries from Thai kids
data.description: Thai children are invited to share their vision for a sustainable world through art for the 17th Kao International Environment Painting Contest, which is accepting entries from young artists aged six to 15 from around the world.

data.title: Reirie and Ash Da Hero promise double-delight this September
data.description: Japanese sensations Reirie and Ash Da Hero to perform their first-ever live shows in Thailand on the same day. Presented by Bandai Namco Music Live and promoted by Live Nation Tero, the performances will take place at Lido Connect Hall 3.

data.title: RBSO marks HM the King's birthday with gala concert
data.description: The Royal Bangkok Symphony Orchestra presents "Royal Benevolence", a gala concert celebrating the auspicious birthday anniversary of HM the King, in the Main Hall of Thailand Cultural Centre, Ratchadaphisek Road, on July 31 at 7.30pm.
